rationale: In response to the user's proposal, the design was framed as four explicit layers: bounded typed metapath extraction, semantic validity scoring (ontology, evidence type, grounded LLM check, learned path encoder), soft proof aggregation (t-norm along a path, noisy-OR across paths) and only then materialised inferred edges. The stated hard part is semantic path selection, not generating indirect associations.
subject: P-16
title: Deduction-like architecture: typed paths, semantic validity and soft proof aggregation
